units: Original Genesis3D units; Y up; seconds; quaternion XYZW
notes: Only original castle BSP models 51, 52, 53, 54 and authored motions are included. This is a button-driven puzzle, not a shove action.
Each geometry position is local to its model origin. Place the model at origin + sampled translation, and use sampled rotation as model quaternion.
All meshes are non-indexed triangle lists. UV values repeat; texture flipY=false and repeat wrap in both directions.
Vertex colors are included as authored/imported geometry colors; no world lightmap is included. A standalone lab may choose its own illumination.
Button contact starts its authored motion; AfterSwitchOn triggers the three crates once the button reaches its on endpoint.
